components.name: HealthScores
components.description: Members gather and curate their FHIR bundle which combines with real-time fitness and vitals to drive a score.  Care Circle members including practitioners are notified when it changes significantly.  EMS personnel and physicians can also participate.
components.notes: We will enable other test patient from the last connectathon.  If you'd like to load you own data let us know at https://www.healthscores.ai/request-access
